ancient-oak.notes: Fix verified: thick trunk ~1/3 canopy width, buttress-root star flares on all sides (front/side/back), broad layered canopy. Biggest nit: trunk reads cut-wood tan, darker bark tones would help.

forest-ground.notes: Flat 2 m tile reads fine; leaf scatter uses contract browns/tan. Biggest issue: base green sits brighter than shaded-floor #4a8a3f and has no sunny #7ec850 dapple variation.

dead-tree.notes: Gnarled silhouette and cut branch tips read, but bark is light orange-tan like cut wood, not bark #8a5a35/#5f3d22. Biggest issue: bark color too light/saturated; green moss splotch on trunk reads neon.

footpath-straight.notes: Fix verified: grass shoulders now match forest-ground's mid shaded green with leaf-litter specks, no longer bright lawn. Sandy path matches mockup dirt. Biggest nit: shoulders a hair lighter than the ground tile.

footpath-corner.notes: Shoulders match forest-ground styling; quarter bend meets tile edges at midpoints. Path color and scatter consistent with footpath-straight. No major issue.

tall-grass.notes: Arcing blades with tan wheat-like seed heads; silhouette reads at sprite size. Biggest nit: blades a bit thick and uniform, could use slight color variation.

mushroom.notes: Cap cluster in contract tans/browns on mossy mound reads clearly. Biggest nit: mound green brighter than shaded floor and stems near-white, slightly off palette.

rock-cluster.notes: Gray stones and moss caps read, but several rocks carry moss where the spec says one moss cap. Biggest issue: wide sandy pancake base plate looks like a dinner plate, not forest floor.

reeds.notes: Cattail heads and green stalks read instantly at sprite size; colors in contract browns/greens. Biggest nit: cattail heads slightly oversized and smooth.

campfire-out.notes: Reads as the lit campfire's pit in a second state: same gray stone ring and log layout, logs charred dark, ash bed present. Biggest nit: ash bed reads near-white rather than gray ash.
